All 19 table rows, heading, every visible cancellation/overprint, all four left pencil leaders, the right braces/brackets and stacked count boxes, all three margin notes, the complete NB paragraph, the complete final paragraph, and the archive numeral were inspected. No part available in the supplied views remains unviewed; no other page or reader was inspected.

notes.text: The page is an undated, unsigned typescript headed “SGA : Manuscripts à frapper”, with pencil cancellations, groupings, leaders and three right-margin notes. No authorial page number is visible. A pencilled 2 at the bottom left is recorded only as an archive sheet number. The identity of the pencil hand is not established by this page.
notes.basis: Observation: whole-page layout and both halves; bottom left archive numeral.

notes.text: The table lists proposed typing work under SGA 1, 4/2, 5, 6 and 7. The entire SGA 1 row and the SGA 6 two-row block are cancelled, including their SGA labels. The SGA 4/2 label and several counts are overtyped; the source permits alternatives recorded in the reading.
notes.basis: Observation: nineteen table content rows, pencil cancellations, sga_digit/iv_count/vib_count crops. No inference from a later published contents list.

notes.text: The NB says underlined figures correspond to exposés whose manuscripts are already available, and source question marks mark exposés whose drafting is uncertain. It also describes variable work on corrections, notes and other errors, proposing a forfait for each seminar after discussing corrections with the “sécrétaire”. The forms “rénumération” and “sécrétaire” are printed as transcribed.
notes.basis: Observation: entire NB paragraph, half b and secrétaire crop. This is a summary of the page, not a proof check.

notes.text: The final paragraph reports approximately 250 pages currently ready, expresses hope for another approximate 200/300 pages for SGA 4 in two or three months, and speaks of 450 to 500 pages over five to six months. It immediately qualifies the expectation: the writer cannot guarantee it, says it depends on Mr. Verdier at Brandeis that year, and will contact him in the coming days. The overtyped approximate count was not resolved by arithmetic from the later total.
notes.basis: Observation: full final paragraph and count200 crop. Counts are transcribed, not independently calculated or verified.

notes.text: The handwritten top-margin surname can be read Saarbach from its strokes. The preceding cluster remains tel/Cl; no identity or expansion is supplied from external knowledge. The other margin notes read écrire Bucur and écr. Deligne, each underlined.
notes.basis: Observation: half a and top_margin crop.

notes.text: No mathematical proposition is asserted or proved on this page, and no mathematical checking was undertaken in this reader run. The task was a complete diplomatic collation of the documentary plan, including its counts, corrections and annotations.
notes.basis: Scope statement: transcription only; check_events intentionally empty.
